data.notes: June 2026 is anchored by Tel Aviv Pride plus a run of high-profile Israeli concerts at Hatikva Stadium, Bloomfield Stadium, Park Ariel Sharon, Heichal HaTarbut, Zappa, and Zocker Hall.

events.title: Dudu Tassa at Hatikva Neighborhood Stadium
events.summary: Dudu Tassa plays a large hometown-style show at Hatikva Neighborhood Stadium with Radio Baghdad, Echo, and a guest list including Yehuda Poliker, Tuna, Mark Eliyahu, and Yehuda Keisar listed by Ticketmaster Israel.

events.title: Yishai Ribo at Kav Rakia – Park Ariel Sharon
events.summary: Yishai Ribo brings a full-band show to the outdoor Kav Rakia stage at Park Ariel Sharon, with doors listed for 19:30 and showtime at 21:00.

events.title: Eyal Golan at Bloomfield Stadium
events.summary: Eyal Golan is listed for a stadium concert at Bloomfield Stadium on 11 June, with additional Tel Aviv dates shown for 13, 14, and 18 June on the same ticket listing.

events.title: Tel Aviv-Yafo Pride Parade 2026
events.summary: Resident Advisor lists the 28th Tel Aviv-Yafo Pride Parade for Friday, 12 June, from 12:00 to 17:00, returning to its seafront parade format along the Shlomo Lahat Promenade and ending at Charles Clore Garden. The music lineup is still marked TBA.

events.title: Maya Belsitzman & Matan Efrat – New Album Launch
events.summary: Maya Belsitzman and Matan Efrat present a new-album launch show at Zocker Hall with an expanded seven-player ensemble and material blending original songs, jazz, world music, and Hebrew song.

events.title: Danny Sanderson at Zappa Tel Aviv
events.summary: Israeli singer-songwriter and guitarist Danny Sanderson is listed by Eventim for a Friday afternoon show at Zappa Tel Aviv.

events.title: Shlomi Shabat & Pablo Rosenberg at Kav Rakia – Park Ariel Sharon
events.summary: Shlomi Shabat and Pablo Rosenberg reunite for a joint show at Kav Rakia, backed by a 10-piece band and focused on hits from their respective catalogues.

events.title: Avraham Tal & Mosh Ben Ari at Kav Rakia – Park Ariel Sharon
events.summary: Avraham Tal and Mosh Ben Ari premiere a new joint show at Kav Rakia, with Ticketmaster listing a live band, a new song, and performances from both artists’ repertoires.

events.title: Yehuda Poliker – Ashes and Dust
events.summary: Yehuda Poliker performs the landmark album “Ashes and Dust” at Heichal HaTarbut with a 13-piece band, combining the album material with classics from across his catalogue.

events.title: Mashina – 40th Anniversary Show
events.summary: Mashina marks 40 years of activity with a Tel Aviv date at Heichal HaTarbut, part of the band’s “Nog‘im BaShamayim” anniversary tour.
